# Contextual integrity of persistent memory: a local diagnostic

36 actual local Qwen generations with fictional IDs. All/recipient/scoped coverage 2/24,0/24,6/24; forbidden selections7/120,0,0. Scope filtering is promising but poor utility remains. Official CIMemories CC BY-NC 4.0 data not downloaded; no native benchmark or product safety claim.

[Code and evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/tree/chatgpt/cimemories-h18-20261127/files/research-artifacts/cimemories-h18-2026-11-27)

Sources: [CIMemories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14937), [official repository](https://github.com/facebookresearch/CIMemories), [Ampersand](https://ampersand.humansand.ai/blog/model-card.html).
